new_scholarship.description: The University of Graz does not award scholarships for incoming international degree students; its Welcome Center states this directly and refers applicants to grants.at. What it does fund is incoming research mobility through three schemes run by the International Office: the Go Styria programme for Master's and doctoral students and post-docs from South-Eastern Europe, paying EUR 900 per month for students and EUR 1,200 per month for post-docs with a tuition-fee exemption at the University of Graz; the Best of South-East scholarship in cooperation with Steiermaerkische Sparkasse, up to EUR 12,000 per person for one academic year; and the Marshall Plan Scholarship for research stays of at least three months, between EUR 4,000 and EUR 10,000. For enrolled students the university offers merit-based scholarships, which require Austrian, EEA or equivalent status.

new_scholarship.name: Johannes Kepler University Linz Scholarships and Grants
new_scholarship.description: JKU Linz lists four groups of scholarships on its own page. The Study Abroad Scholarship funds a study-relevant stay abroad. Merit Scholarships and Study Grants recognise on-time completion with an average GPA of no less than 2.0, or support a Diploma or Master's thesis or doctoral dissertation, and are awarded annually from funds made available by the Austrian Federal Ministry of Science, Research and the Economy. Since 2015 JKU has been part of the UNIKO MORE initiative, supporting refugee students in the university preparation programme MOREclassic and in a regular degree programme through the Borealis-MORE-Scholarship, sponsored by Borealis AG. The Department of Equality also offers the annual IRIS FISCHLMAYR Scholarships and Awards and, since 2026, the Soroptimist Award. For applicants who do not qualify, the page refers to the Austrian Study Grant Authority and the Upper Austrian Chamber of Labor scholarship calculator.
